E5.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E5.text: Born | Yvonne Jaqueline Strzechowski (1982-07-30) 30 July 1982 Sydney, Australia

E12.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E12.text: The family moved to the suburb of Bass Hill when Strahovski was five years old; later, they moved to the coastal suburb of Maroubra.

E13.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E13.text: Strahovski began acting lessons at the age of 12.

E14.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E14.text: Straight after high school, she went to the University of Western Sydney's Theatre Nepean, where she graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree in performance in 2003.

E15.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E15.text: Strahovski then worked professionally in theatre in Australia for three years before landing a role in the American television series Chuck.

E16.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E16.text: In December 2012, she made her Broadway debut in a revival of Clifford Odets' Golden Boy, for which she won a Theatre World Award.

E17.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E17.text: Strahovski was honored along with Liam Hemsworth for their work in international roles with the 2012 Australians in Film Breakthrough Award.

E19.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E19.text: Strahovski was born Yvonne Jaqueline Strzechowski on 30 July 1982 in Werrington Downs, a suburb of Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

E20.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E20.text: She is the only child of Bożena, a lab technician, and Peter Strzechowski, an electronics engineer.

E21.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E21.text: Her parents are Polish emigrants from Tomaszów Mazowiecki.

E28.text: In 2025, Strahovski joined the cast of the The Legend of Zelda live-action film.

E42.title: Yvonne
E42.text: Yvonne Mitchell (1915–1979), English actress and author

E43.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E43.text: Strahovski sent in her audition tape for the TV series Chuck while in the United States auditioning for roles in other shows, namely NBC's 2007 series Bionic Woman.

E44.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E44.text: She was cast as Sarah Walker after running lines with Zachary Levi.

E45.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E45.text: She relocated to the United States six months later.

E46.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E46.text: Strahovski adopted the more phonetic spelling of Strahovski as her stage name in place of Strzechowski at this time.

E48.title: Yvonne
E48.text: Yvonne Hudson (born 1955), American actress and comedian

E51.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E51.text: In addition to English, Strahovski is fluent in Polish, and employed it in a brief exchange with a colleague in the Chuck episode "Chuck Versus the Wookiee" and again in the episodes "Chuck Versus the Three Words" and "Chuck Versus the Honeymooners".

E52.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E52.text: Although she portrays an American in the series, she briefly spoke in a "Hollywood" Australian accent in the episode "Chuck Versus the Ex".

E54.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E54.text: Her other notable works include Lego: The Adventures of Clutch Powers (2010), The Guilt Trip (2012), Killer Elite (2011), I, Frankenstein (2014), The Astronaut Wives Club (2015), Manhattan Night (2016), All I See Is You (2016), He's Out There (2018), The Predator (2018) and The Tomorrow War (2021).

E55.title: Yvonne Strahovski
E55.text: She voiced Miranda Lawson in the Mass Effect video game series and Batwoman in the animated superhero film Batman: Bad Blood (2016).
